name: Selling an equity ETF after 10 years, the Vorabpauschalen in its cost
workings: Bought for 100,000 in January 2026, up 7% a year; the ten Vorabpauschalen (2,240.00 … 4,118.15) total 30,948.84, already in the purchase cost: 130,948.84
Gain 65,766.2923; 70% after the partial exemption, less the 1,000 allowance: 45,036.4046
2035 with 2026's parameters, inflation factor 1 (nominal amounts) and realWageGrowth 0, so the salary is taxed as in employee-75k
Changed from the draft: a salary keeps the Günstigerprüfung from applying (as in vorabpauschale-year)
